verdicts.reason: A uses a proper left-to-right banner split, but the headline runs almost into the right column with a gutter of only about 20px. The subcopy is squeezed into a narrow, centred, four-line stack with ragged breaks ('Now in four / flavours.'), and the CTA and headline sit close to the bottom edge. B keeps the original centred stack and its clear hierarchy cleanly, but the one-line headline nearly touches both side edges (about 18px margins), and the headline, subcopy and CTA are stacked tightly with little breathing room.
